Name: Additional Image ID
Description: The Additional Image ID extension is used for storage and retrieval from standard imagery libraries. AIMID is a required component of all airborne imagery files. A single AIMID is placed in the respective subheader of every NITF image segment . Data from AIMID are copied into the first forty characters of the image subheader ITITLE (NITF 2.0) or IID2 (NITF 2.1) field.

MISSION_DATE.Name: Aircraft T.O. Date
MISSION_DATE.Description: The date of the collection mission (date of aircraft takeoff) in the format DDMMMYY, in which DD is the day of the month (01-31), MMM is the first three characters of the month (JAN to DEC), and YY is the last two digits of the year (00 to 99).

MISSION_NO.Name: Mission ID
MISSION_NO.Description: This is a four character descriptor of the mission. Contents are user defined, except that at least one character must not be numeric.

FLIGHT_NO.Name: Flight Number
FLIGHT_NO.Description: This field is describes for each flight a value used to identify the flight number within a range of 01 to 09. Flight 01 shall be the first flight of the day, flight 02 the second, etc. In order to ensure uniqueness in the image id, if the aircraft mission extends across midnight UTC, the flight number shall be 0x (where x is in the range 0 to 9) on images acquired before midnight UTC and Ax on images acquired after midnight UTC; for extended missions Bx, and Zx shall designate images acquired on subsequent days. The value 00 indicates the flight number is unavailable.

OP_NUM.Name: Image Operation Number
OP_NUM.Description: This field specifies the imaging operation for each flight.  Make sure to reset the value to 001 at the start of each flight. A value of 000 indicates the airborne system does not number imaging operations.

START_SEGMENT.Name: Start Segment ID
START_SEGMENT.Description: This field identifies images as separate pieces (segments) within an imaging operation. AA is the first segment; AB is the second segment, etc. Spaces indicate the image is not segmented.

REPRO_NUM.Name: Reprocess Number
REPRO_NUM.Description: The reprocess number for SAR imagery indicates whether the data was reprocessed to overcome initial processing failures, or has been enhanced. A '00' in this field indicates that the data is an originally processed image, a '01' indicates the first reprocess/enhancement, etc. In the case of visible and infrared imagery this field shall contain 00 to indicate no reprocessing or enhancement.

REPLAY.Name: Retransmission Number
REPLAY.Description: This field indicates whether the data was reprocessed to overcome initial processing failures, or retransmitted to overcome transmission errors. A 000 in this field indicates that the data is an originally processed and transmitted image, a value in the ranges of G01 to G99 or P01 to P99 indicates the data is reprocessed, and a value in the range of T01 to T99 indicates it was retransmitted.

RESVD001.Name: Reserved 1
RESVD001.Description: This field is reserved and used only to maintain alignment and functional equivalence for systems beyond the scope of this document.

START_COLUMN.Name: Starting Tile Column
START_COLUMN.Description: This field is for tiled (blocked) sub-images, where the number of the first tile relative to start of the original image tiling within this segment. Tiles are rectangular arrays of pixels that subdivide an image. For untiled images this field shall contain 01.

START_ROW.Name: Starting Tile Row
START_ROW.Description: This field is for tiled (blocked) sub-images, the number of the first tile relative to start of the original image tiling within this segment. For untiled images this field shall contain 00001.

END_SEGMENT.Name: Ending Segment
END_SEGMENT.Description: This is the ending segment ID of this file.  Spaces indicate the image is not segmented.

END_COLUMN.Name: Ending Tile Column
END_COLUMN.Description: This is for tiled (blocked) sub-images, the number of the last tile relative to start of the original image tiling within this segment. For untiled images this field shall contain 01.

END_ROW.Name: Ending Tile Row
END_ROW.Description: This is for tiled (blocked) sub-images, the number of the last tile relative to start of the original image tiling within this segment. For untiled images this field shall contain 00001.

COUNTRY.Name: Country Code
COUNTRY.Description: This is a two letter code defining the country for the reference point of the image. Standard codes may be found in FIPS PUB 10-4.

RESVD002.Name: Reserved 2
RESVD002.Description: This field is reserved and used only to maintain alignment and functional equivalence for systems beyond the scope of this document.

LOCATION.Name: Location lat/long
LOCATION.Description: This field represents the location of the center of the first image block, provides rough indication of geographic coverage. The format ddmmX represents degrees (00-89) and minutes (00-59) of latitude, with X = N or S for north or south, and dddmmY represents degrees (000- 179) and minutes (00-59) of longitude, with Y = E or W for east or west, respectively.

TIME.Name: Time of First Line
TIME.Description: This field shall contain the collection time referenced to UTC, and accurate to 1 minute, of the first line of the image in the format hhmmZ, in which hh is the hour (00-23), and mm is the minute (00-59); the final character 'Z' is required.

CREATION_DATE.Name: Date of First Line
CREATION_DATE.Description: This field shall contain the collection date of the first line of the image in the format DDMMMYY, in which DD is the day of the month (01 to 31), MMM is the first three characters of the month (JAN to DEC), and YY is the last two digits of the year (00 to 99). This date is coordinated with the collection time, i.e., the date changes at midnight UTC.
